rca_of_the_issue: The previous frontend onChange handlers sanitized DLT IDs with replace(/\D/g, '') and sanitized variable names with a character-class regex, stripping user-entered letters or hyphens before save. The verified fix stores raw e.target.value for all three DLT fields and removes numeric inputMode from the DLT ID fields, so typed/pasted alphanumeric IDs are no longer mutated before PUT.
